node.title: Logic for importing and strict vars?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi everyone, I'm looking for some documentation on why the fourth of these examples is an error:

$ perl -wMstrict -e 'BEGIN { package blah; *::x=sub{} } x' $ perl -wMstrict -e 'BEGIN { *::x=sub{} } x' $ perl -wMstrict -e 'BEGIN { package blah; *::x=\$a } $x++' $ perl -wMstrict -e 'BEGIN { *::x=\$a } $x++' Variable "$x" is not imported at -e line 1. Global symbol "$x" requires explicit package name (did you forget to declare "my $x"?) at -e line 1. Execution of -e aborted due to compilation errors.

The explanation for why is [id://522234|here], so I'm really just looking for something in the official Perl docs, but I haven't found it yet. Any help would be appreciated :-)

Update: Thanks very much for all the replies! :-)
